text: I called them and asked if they could deliver the food and they just hanged up on me . So when i went there I order a cheese burger and fries and a normal water. The cheeseburger had mold on it and the meat was not cooked and the fries had hair on them and were overcooked and they were wet for some reason. They didn’t even give me sauce. The water was okay but it wasn’t cold it was warm and they put salt in my water just beacause I complained about the hair on my fries . And they were very rude because they had put made a hole in the burger with they’re finger 🤢🤮.   🫩✌️🥀🥀🥀

text:
Não recomendo mesmo!
Carne estava queimada e com gosto da chapa. Queijo não estava derretido, assim o hambúrguer estava horrível.
Sobre o serviço gostaria de não ter visto o que vi antes de comer. TODOS os funcionários estavam sem luvas e tocando com a mão (que não sabemos onde colocaram antes) nas carnes, queijos e etc. Não sei se é algo normal na Europa mas de onde eu vim chamamos isso de falta de higiene e porquice
Além disso o local estava extremamente sujo. Milkshake jogado pelo chão inteiro do restaurante.
